start: Read live GitHub first. Resolve the current authority ref, fetch the generation record at that exact commit, materialize the selected Library file_id, verify size_bytes and sha256, then read summary.json; follow attachment descriptors only as needed. Never use an older generation as current if the selected object is unavailable. GitHub requirements and live PR/CI remain authoritative. Publish new snapshots by expected-head non-force CAS on anet/memory; reread ref. No private financial data or secrets in public GitHub.
